subhero.en: Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) costs $4 per month at Walmart in 2026. Generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) runs $4 to $15 with a GoodRx coupon, and generic simvastatin (Zocor) is available for $4 at most major chains. Brand-name Lipitor, Crestor, and Zocor cost $300 to $700 per month without insurance. Medicare Part D covers all three generics as Tier 1 preferred generics with $0 to $5 monthly copays. This page compares 2026 cash prices by pharmacy chain, Medicare Part D and Medicaid coverage, and the manufacturer patient assistance programs for brand-name versions.
subhero.es: La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) cuesta $4 por mes en Walmart en 2026. La rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) cuesta entre $4 y $15 con un cupon GoodRx, y la simvastatina generica (Zocor) esta disponible a $4 en la mayoria de las principales cadenas. Las marcas Lipitor, Crestor y Zocor cuestan entre $300 y $700 por mes sin seguro. Medicare Parte D cubre los tres genericos como genericos preferidos de Nivel 1 con copagos mensuales de $0 a $5.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, all three major brand-name statins have affordable generics: atorvastatin (generic Lipitor) costs $4 per month at Walmart, generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) costs $4 to $15 with a GoodRx coupon, and generic simvastatin (Zocor) costs $4 at most chains. Brand-name Lipitor retails near $430 to $700 per month; brand Crestor near $300 to $420 per month. Medicare Part D covers all generic statins on Tier 1 or Tier 2 with $0 to $5 copays, subject to the 2026 annual $2,100 Part D out-of-pocket cap. For uninsured patients who cannot afford even the low generic prices, Pfizer RxPathways covers brand Lipitor and AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program covers brand Crestor for incomes at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level. No manufacturer patient assistance program is necessary for generic statins at $4 per month.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, las tres principales estatinas de marca tienen genericos asequibles: la atorvastatina (Lipitor generico) cuesta $4 por mes en Walmart, la rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) cuesta entre $4 y $15 con un cupon GoodRx, y la simvastatina generica (Zocor) cuesta $4 en la mayoria de las cadenas. El Lipitor de marca cuesta cerca de $430 a $700 por mes; el Crestor de marca cerca de $300 a $420 por mes. Medicare Parte D cubre todos los genericos de estatinas en el Nivel 1 o 2 con copagos de $0 a $5, sujeto al limite anual de $2,100 de Parte D de 2026. Para pacientes sin seguro que no pueden pagar los bajos precios genericos, Pfizer RxPathways cubre el Lipitor de marca y el programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca cubre el Crestor de marca para ingresos iguales o inferiores al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza.

note.en: All three major branded statins have been off-patent for years. Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) has been available since November 2011. Generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) has been available since 2016. Generic simvastatin (Zocor) has been available since 2006. No biologics or biosimilars exist for any statin because all statins are small-molecule synthetic drugs. As of 2026, more than 20 FDA-approved manufacturers produce generic atorvastatin, and over 15 produce generic rosuvastatin. Generic versions are bioequivalent to their brand-name counterparts and cost 90 to 98 percent less.
note.es: Las tres principales estatinas de marca llevan anos sin patente. La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) esta disponible desde noviembre de 2011. La rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) esta disponible desde 2016. La simvastatina generica (Zocor) esta disponible desde 2006. No existen biologicos ni biosimilares para ninguna estatina porque todas son farmacos sinteticos de molecula pequena. A partir de 2026, mas de 20 fabricantes aprobados por la FDA producen atorvastatina generica, y mas de 15 producen rosuvastatina generica.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice (Explanation of Benefits) from your insurer to confirm the exact denial reason, such as non-formulary status, step therapy requirement, or prior authorization denial.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito (Explicacion de Beneficios) de su aseguradora para confirmar el motivo exacto de denegacion, como estado fuera del formulario, requisito de terapia escalonada o denegacion de autorizacion previa.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: Ask your prescriber to file a coverage exception or prior authorization request citing the clinical need for the specific statin prescribed. Most generic statin prior authorizations for standard cardiovascular indications are approved quickly.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Pida a su medico que presente una solicitud de excepcion de cobertura o autorizacion previa citando la necesidad clinica del estatinico especifico recetado.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: If the appeal is denied, file a formal Level 2 appeal within 60 days. For Medicare Part D, you can request an Independent Review Entity review through CMS at 1-800-MEDICARE.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Si se niega la apelacion, presente una apelacion formal de Nivel 2 dentro de los 60 dias. Para Medicare Parte D, puede solicitar una revision de una Entidad de Revision Independiente a traves de CMS al 1-800-MEDICARE.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: Escalate to external review through your state Department of Insurance if the internal appeals fail. All ACA-regulated plans must offer external review.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Escale a revision externa a traves del Departamento de Seguros de su estado si las apelaciones internas fallan. Todos los planes regulados por la ACA deben ofrecer revision externa.

stepTherapyOverride.en: Many insurance plans require patients to try a lower-cost statin before approving a specific statin under step therapy. If your plan requires simvastatin or pravastatin before covering atorvastatin or rosuvastatin, your prescriber can file a step-therapy override documenting that the required statin caused side effects, drug interactions, or was insufficient to meet your LDL target. Most statin step-therapy overrides are approved within 72 hours when properly documented.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Muchos planes de seguro requieren que los pacientes prueben una estatina de menor costo antes de aprobar una estatina especifica bajo terapia escalonada. Si su plan requiere simvastatina o pravastatina antes de cubrir atorvastatina o rosuvastatina, su medico puede presentar una anulacion de terapia escalonada documentando que la estatina requerida causo efectos secundarios, interacciones medicamentosas o fue insuficiente para alcanzar su objetivo de LDL.

papFallback.en: If all appeals fail, apply for the manufacturer patient assistance program. Pfizer RxPathways provides brand Lipitor at no cost for uninsured and government-insured patients with household income at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level. AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program provides brand Crestor free for qualifying patients. For generic statins, no manufacturer PAP is necessary because the $4 generic at Walmart is cheaper than any manufacturer copay program.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones fallan, solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente del fabricante. Pfizer RxPathways proporciona Lipitor de marca sin costo para pacientes sin seguro y con seguro del gobierno con ingresos familiares iguales o inferiores al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza. El programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca proporciona Crestor de marca gratis para pacientes que califican.

genericAlternative.en: Generic alternative: All three major brand statins have FDA-approved bioequivalent generics available for $4 to $15 per month at major pharmacy chains. Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor), rosuvastatin (Crestor), and simvastatin (Zocor) are therapeutically equivalent to their brand-name counterparts. Switching from a brand statin to its generic requires only a pharmacist substitution in most states. Discuss with your prescriber whether a lower-cost statin generic or a therapeutic statin switch is appropriate for your LDL target.
genericAlternative.es: Alternativa generica: Las tres principales estatinas de marca tienen genericos bioequivalentes aprobados por la FDA disponibles a $4 a $15 por mes en las principales cadenas de farmacias. La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor), la rosuvastatina (Crestor) y la simvastatina (Zocor) son terapeuticamente equivalentes a sus contrapartes de marca. Cambiar de una estatina de marca a su generico generalmente solo requiere sustitucion por el farmaceutico.

howToApplyPap.programName: Pfizer RxPathways Patient Assistance Program (for Lipitor) and AstraZeneca AZ&Me (for Crestor)

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Confirm you need brand-name Lipitor or Crestor. If you can use the generic (atorvastatin or rosuvastatin), the $4 to $15 cash price at major pharmacies is cheaper and faster than a PAP. Only proceed if your prescriber has documented a clinical need for the brand.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Confirme que necesita el Lipitor o Crestor de marca. Si puede usar el generico (atorvastatina o rosuvastatina), el precio de $4 a $15 en efectivo en las principales farmacias es mas barato y rapido que un PAP. Continua solo si su medico ha documentado una necesidad clinica para la marca.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: For Lipitor, visit pfizerrxpathways.com or call 1-844-989-PATH (7284) to begin the Pfizer RxPathways application. For Crestor, visit azandme.com or call 1-800-AZandMe (1-800-292-6363).
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Para Lipitor, visite pfizerrxpathways.com o llame al 1-844-989-PATH (7284) para iniciar la solicitud de Pfizer RxPathways. Para Crestor, visite azandme.com o llame al 1-800-AZandMe (1-800-292-6363).

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: most recent federal income tax return or 4 consecutive pay stubs, proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific brand-name statin, and documentation showing no other prescription drug insurance coverage (or for Medicare patients, proof that a copay reduction has been applied for).
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reunir documentos requeridos: declaracion de impuestos federales mas reciente o 4 talonarios de pago consecutivos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida para la estatina de marca especifica y documentacion que muestre que no tiene otra cobertura de medicamentos recetados.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Complete the online enrollment or download, fill, and fax the patient application with your prescriber's signature. AZ&Me fax number is 1-877-239-0867. Pfizer applications can be submitted online through Pfizer PAP Connect.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Complete la inscripcion en linea o descargue, complete y envie por fax la solicitud del paciente con la firma de su medico. El numero de fax de AZ&Me es 1-877-239-0867. Las solicitudes de Pfizer se pueden enviar en linea a traves de Pfizer PAP Connect.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: Processing typically takes 7 to 14 business days. If approved, the brand medication is shipped directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Annual renewal is required for both programs.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: El procesamiento generalmente toma de 7 a 14 dias habiles. Si se aprueba, el medicamento de marca se envia directamente a su hogar o al consultorio de su medico sin cargo. Se requiere renovacion anual para ambos programas.

introParagraphs.en: Statins are HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors, the most-prescribed class of cholesterol-lowering drugs in the United States. The three largest-selling statins by prescription volume are atorvastatin (brand name Lipitor), rosuvastatin (brand name Crestor), and simvastatin (brand name Zocor). All three have been off-patent for years and are available as cheap FDA-approved generics. Generic atorvastatin became available in November 2011, generic simvastatin in 2006, and generic rosuvastatin in 2016 after AstraZeneca's last Crestor patent expired. Because all three are now generic, the actual 2026 cash price for any of them ranges from $4 to $15 per month at most major pharmacy chains, with Walmart offering atorvastatin and simvastatin at $4 per month through its $4 Generic Prescription Program.
introParagraphs.es: Las estatinas son inhibidores de la HMG-CoA reductasa, la clase mas recetada de medicamentos para reducir el colesterol en los Estados Unidos. Las tres estatinas de mayor venta por volumen de recetas son la atorvastatina (nombre comercial Lipitor), la rosuvastatina (nombre comercial Crestor) y la simvastatina (nombre comercial Zocor). Las tres llevan anos sin patente y estan disponibles como genericos economicos aprobados por la FDA. La atorvastatina generica estuvo disponible en noviembre de 2011, la simvastatina generica en 2006 y la rosuvastatina generica en 2016 despues de que expiro la ultima patente de Crestor de AstraZeneca.

introParagraphs.en: Despite the low generic prices, hospital inpatient bills routinely show statin charges of $50 to $300 per tablet due to facility-rate markups that bundle the drug acquisition cost with nursing administration, pharmacy handling, and overhead fees. Patients who receive brand-name Lipitor or Crestor without insurance face retail cash prices of $300 to $700 per month. For those patients, two manufacturer-run patient assistance programs can provide the brand drugs at no cost: Pfizer RxPathways for Lipitor, and AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program for Crestor. Both programs use a 300 percent of the federal poverty level income threshold for uninsured and government-insured patients. Commercially insured patients are not eligible for these programs. For commercially insured patients denied coverage, a formulary exception or step-therapy override is the standard first step before appealing.
introParagraphs.es: A pesar de los bajos precios genericos, las facturas hospitalarias muestran cargos de estatinas de $50 a $300 por tableta debido a los recargos de la tarifa de instalacion. Los pacientes que reciben Lipitor o Crestor de marca sin seguro enfrentan precios al por menor de $300 a $700 por mes. Para esos pacientes, dos programas de asistencia al paciente del fabricante pueden proporcionar los medicamentos de marca sin costo: Pfizer RxPathways para Lipitor y el programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca para Crestor.

introParagraphs.en: Atorvastatin remains the workhorse statin for most patients because it offers the strongest LDL reduction per dollar. Rosuvastatin (generic Crestor) is slightly more potent at equivalent doses and preferred for patients who need maximum LDL reduction or have interactions with atorvastatin's cytochrome P450 3A4 metabolism pathway. Simvastatin is the oldest commonly prescribed statin and is primarily used in patients already stabilized on it; the FDA placed an 80 mg dose warning in 2011 due to myopathy risk, making atorvastatin and rosuvastatin preferred for high-intensity statin therapy. None of the three statins is subject to IRA Medicare price negotiation as of 2026 because all are generic and available at low cost without negotiation. Under Medicare Part D, all three fall under the general 2026 annual $2,100 out-of-pocket cap established by the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022.
introParagraphs.es: La atorvastatina sigue siendo la estatina de referencia para la mayoria de los pacientes porque ofrece la mayor reduccion de LDL por dolar. La rosuvastatina (Crestor generico) es ligeramente mas potente a dosis equivalentes y es preferida para pacientes que necesitan maxima reduccion de LDL. La simvastatina es la estatina mas antigua de uso comun. Ninguna de las tres estatinas esta sujeta a la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion a partir de 2026 porque todas son genericas y estan disponibles a bajo costo.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals bill oral medications at facility rates that bundle the drug acquisition cost with markup for nursing administration, pharmacy dispensing, storage, and overhead. Generic atorvastatin that the hospital acquires for under $0.50 per tablet can appear on an itemized inpatient bill at $50 to $300 per dose. A 7-day hospital stay continuing a patient's home statin regimen at one tablet per day can produce a $350 to $2,100 statin line item on the hospital bill for a drug that costs $4 per month at the corner pharmacy. Hospitals are required by CMS Hospital Price Transparency rules to publish their chargemaster rates, but those published rates are starting prices, not final negotiated amounts.
paragraphs.es: Los hospitales facturan los medicamentos orales a tarifas de instalacion que incluyen el costo de adquisicion del medicamento mas recargo por administracion de enfermeria, dispensacion de farmacia, almacenamiento y gastos generales. La atorvastatina generica que el hospital adquiere por menos de $0.50 por tableta puede aparecer en una factura hospitalaria detallada a $50 a $300 por dosis. Una estancia hospitalaria de 7 dias continuando el regimen de estatinas del paciente puede producir una partida de estatinas de $350 a $2,100 en la factura del hospital para un medicamento que cuesta $4 por mes en la farmacia.

paragraphs.en: Because statins have no Medicare Part B ASP rate (they are oral Part D drugs), there is no single federal benchmark price that inpatient bills must honor. Patients can challenge inflated statin charges by requesting an itemized bill, looking up the National Drug Code (NDC) on the bill, and comparing the charge to the retail generic cash price. Charges more than 100 times above the retail generic price are standard dispute targets. Requesting a reduction to cost plus a reasonable pharmacy administration fee is a common and frequently successful approach for billing departments at hospitals that have financial hardship or charity care programs.
paragraphs.es: Dado que las estatinas no tienen tarifa ASP de Medicare Parte B (son medicamentos orales de Parte D), no hay un precio de referencia federal unico que las facturas hospitalarias deban respetar. Los pacientes pueden impugnar los cargos inflados de estatinas solicitando una factura detallada, buscando el Codigo Nacional de Medicamento (NDC) en la factura y comparando el cargo con el precio generico al por menor en efectivo.

paragraphs.en: A common scenario: a patient admitted for a cardiac catheterization continues atorvastatin 40 mg daily during the hospital stay. The hospital dispenses the same generic tablet available for $4 per month at Walmart. The inpatient bill shows $80 per tablet for 3 days, totaling $240 in atorvastatin charges. That $240 charge for a drug costing less than $0.50 per tablet to acquire is a standard dispute target. The CoveredUSA Medical Bill Analyzer flags statin charges above $10 per tablet as automatic review items, and most patients who challenge these charges obtain a reduction.
paragraphs.es: Un escenario comun: un paciente admitido para un cateterismo cardiaco continua con atorvastatina 40 mg diaria durante la estancia hospitalaria. El hospital dispensa la misma tableta generica disponible por $4 por mes en Walmart. La factura hospitalaria muestra $80 por tableta durante 3 dias, totalizando $240 en cargos de atorvastatina. Ese cargo de $240 por un medicamento que cuesta menos de $0.50 por tableta adquirirlo es un objetivo estandar de disputa.

intro.en: Both Pfizer (maker of brand Lipitor) and AstraZeneca (maker of brand Crestor) run manufacturer patient assistance programs for uninsured and government-insured patients who cannot afford the brand-name statin. For uninsured patients who can take generic statins, the $4 generic at Walmart is cheaper than any PAP and requires no application. The PAPs below are relevant only if your prescriber has documented a clinical need for the brand-name product and generic statins are not clinically appropriate.
intro.es: Tanto Pfizer (fabricante de Lipitor de marca) como AstraZeneca (fabricante de Crestor de marca) administran programas de asistencia al paciente del fabricante para pacientes sin seguro y con seguro del gobierno que no pueden pagar la estatina de marca. Para pacientes sin seguro que pueden tomar estatinas genericas, el generico de $4 en Walmart es mas barato que cualquier PAP y no requiere solicitud. Los PAP a continuacion son relevantes solo si su medico ha documentado una necesidad clinica para el producto de marca.

costBenefit.en: Free brand-name Lipitor for uninsured and government-insured patients with household income at or below 300% FPL
costBenefit.es: Lipitor de marca gratis para pacientes sin seguro y con seguro del gobierno con ingresos familiares iguales o inferiores al 300% del FPL

costBenefit.en: Free brand-name Crestor for uninsured patients with household income at or below 300% FPL for primary care products
costBenefit.es: Crestor de marca gratis para pacientes sin seguro con ingresos familiares iguales o inferiores al 300% del FPL para productos de atencion primaria

costBenefit.en: Variable discount on generic and brand statins at most US pharmacies, accepted regardless of income or insurance status
costBenefit.es: Descuento variable en estatinas genericas y de marca en la mayoria de las farmacias de EE.UU., aceptado independientemente del ingreso o estado de seguro

costBenefit.en: Reduces generic statin cash prices to $4 to $25 per month at most major chains; free to use with no application required
costBenefit.es: Reduce los precios en efectivo de estatinas genericas a $4 a $25 por mes en la mayoria de las cadenas principales; gratis de usar sin solicitud requerida

footnote.en: Manufacturer savings cards and PAPs are not available to commercially insured patients for Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me. Federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) bars manufacturer copay cards from Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, and VA beneficiaries. If you have government insurance and cannot afford your statin copay, use the Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me income-based PAP instead. For most patients on Medicare Part D, generic atorvastatin or rosuvastatin will be on Tier 1 with a $0 to $5 copay, making the PAP unnecessary.
footnote.es: Las tarjetas de ahorro del fabricante y los PAP no estan disponibles para pacientes con seguro comercial para Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe que las tarjetas de copago del fabricante sean usadas por beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE y VA. Si tiene seguro del gobierno y no puede pagar su copago de estatinas, utilice el PAP basado en ingresos de Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me.

paragraphs.en: Generic atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, and simvastatin are all covered by Medicare Part D plans. All three are placed on Tier 1 (preferred generic) or Tier 2 (generic) on virtually every Part D formulary, with copays of $0 to $5 per month. There is no drug-specific monthly cap for statins under the Inflation Reduction Act. Statin spending falls under the general 2026 Medicare Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100, after which you pay $0 for all covered drugs for the rest of the calendar year. Because generic statins are so inexpensive, you are extremely unlikely to reach the $2,100 cap from statin spending alone.
paragraphs.es: La atorvastatina generica, la rosuvastatina y la simvastatina estan cubiertas por los planes de Medicare Parte D. Las tres se colocan en el Nivel 1 (generico preferido) o Nivel 2 (generico) en practicamente todos los formularios de Parte D, con copagos de $0 a $5 por mes. No existe un limite mensual especifico para las estatinas bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion. El gasto en estatinas cae bajo el limite anual general de Medicare Parte D de $2,100 de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Statins are not subject to IRA Medicare price negotiation and no statin has a Maximum Fair Price under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. The IRA negotiation program targets brand-name drugs without generic competition that account for high Medicare spending. Because atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, and simvastatin are already available as inexpensive generics, they do not qualify for and do not need a negotiated Maximum Fair Price. Brand Lipitor, Crestor, and Zocor remain on some Part D formularies as Tier 3 or Tier 4 drugs, but no patient needs to pay $300 to $700 per month for a statin when the bioequivalent generic costs $4 at Walmart. If your Part D plan is placing any statin on a high tier, request a formulary exception or compare plans during open enrollment (October 15 to December 7) using the Medicare Plan Finder at medicare.gov.
paragraphs.es: Las estatinas no estan sujetas a la negociacion de precios de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion porque ya son genericas y economicas. La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022 se dirige a medicamentos de marca sin competencia generica que representan un alto gasto de Medicare. Si su plan Parte D esta colocando cualquier estatina en un nivel alto, solicite una excepcion al formulario o compare planes durante la inscripcion abierta usando el Buscador de Planes de Medicare en medicare.gov.

paragraphs.en: Medicare beneficiaries who also qualify for Medicaid (dual-eligible or dual-special needs plan enrollees) typically pay $0 to $4 for generic statins under the Extra Help (Low-Income Subsidy) program. Applying for Extra Help can be done through the Social Security Administration at ssa.gov/extrahelp or at your local Social Security office. Most dual-eligible Medicare patients pay nothing for generic statins all year.
paragraphs.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare que tambien califican para Medicaid (doble elegibles) tipicamente pagan $0 a $4 por estatinas genericas bajo el programa de Ayuda Extra (Subsidio de Bajos Ingresos). Solicitar Ayuda Extra se puede hacer a traves de la Administracion del Seguro Social en ssa.gov/extrahelp. La mayoria de los pacientes de Medicare con doble elegibilidad no pagan nada por las estatinas genericas durante todo el ano.

intro.en: If your hospital bill shows $50 or more per statin tablet, or if your pharmacy bill for a generic statin exceeds $30 per month, check for these common billing errors before paying:
intro.es: Si su factura hospitalaria muestra $50 o mas por tableta de estatinas, o si su factura de farmacia por una estatina generica supera los $30 por mes, verifique estos errores comunes de facturacion antes de pagar:

items.en: Brand Lipitor or Crestor billed when the generic was actually dispensed: brand substitution errors add $300 to $700 per month to your bill. Always confirm the dispensed NDC on your receipt matches the generic.
items.es: Lipitor o Crestor de marca facturado cuando en realidad se dispenso el generico: los errores de sustitucion de marca agregan $300 a $700 por mes a su factura. Siempre confirme que el NDC dispensado en su recibo coincide con el generico.

items.en: Wrong formulary tier applied by the pharmacy: if your Part D plan shows a statin at Tier 3 or higher copay but it should be Tier 1, the pharmacy may have keyed an incorrect drug code. Ask the pharmacist to reprocess the claim.
items.es: Nivel de formulario incorrecto aplicado por la farmacia: si su plan Parte D muestra una estatina con copago de Nivel 3 o superior cuando deberia ser Nivel 1, la farmacia puede haber ingresado un codigo de medicamento incorrecto. Pida al farmaceutico que reprocese el reclamo.

items.en: Inpatient charge for a dose held per clinical order: statins are sometimes held before a surgical procedure or when a patient is on a restricted diet. If the dose was held but still billed, this is a dispute item.
items.es: Cargo hospitalario por una dosis retenida por orden clinica: las estatinas a veces se retienen antes de un procedimiento quirurgico. Si la dosis fue retenida pero aun facturada, este es un item de disputa.

items.en: High-dose strength billed when a lower dose was ordered: atorvastatin 80 mg billed when 40 mg was ordered can double the per-tablet charge.
items.es: Concentracion de dosis alta facturada cuando se ordeno una dosis mas baja: atorvastatina 80 mg facturada cuando se ordeno 40 mg puede duplicar el cargo por tableta.

items.en: Prior authorization denial not appealed: if commercial insurance denied statin coverage claiming non-formulary status, and your prescriber's office did not file an appeal, you may be paying cash unnecessarily. Generic statins are covered by nearly every plan.
items.es: Denegacion de autorizacion previa no apelada: si el seguro comercial nego la cobertura de estatinas alegando estado fuera del formulario y el consultorio de su medico no presento una apelacion, puede estar pagando en efectivo innecesariamente.

en.question: What is the cheapest statin in 2026?
en.answer: Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) and generic simvastatin (Zocor) are both available for $4 per month at Walmart through the $4 Generic Prescription Program, with no insurance required. Generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) is available for $4 to $9 at most major chains with a free GoodRx coupon. All three are therapeutically effective for lowering LDL cholesterol. Atorvastatin is the most commonly prescribed because it offers strong LDL reduction at a $4 price point. If you are paying more than $25 per month for any generic statin, show your pharmacist a free GoodRx coupon from goodrx.com.

en.question: Is there a generic for Lipitor, Crestor, and Zocor?
en.answer: Yes. All three major brand-name statins have FDA-approved bioequivalent generics. Generic atorvastatin (Lipitor) has been available since November 2011. Generic simvastatin (Zocor) has been available since 2006. Generic rosuvastatin (Crestor) has been available since 2016 after AstraZeneca's last patents expired. As of 2026, more than 20 manufacturers produce generic atorvastatin and over 15 produce generic rosuvastatin. There are no biologics or biosimilars for any statin because statins are small-molecule synthetic drugs, not biologics.

en.question: How do I apply for the patient assistance program for Lipitor or Crestor?
en.answer: For brand Lipitor, apply through Pfizer RxPathways at pfizerrxpathways.com or call 1-844-989-PATH (7284). For brand Crestor, apply through AstraZeneca's AZ&Me program at azandme.com or call 1-800-292-6363. Both programs require household income at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level, a valid prescription, and proof of no commercial drug insurance. Processing takes 7 to 14 business days. For most patients, the generic statin at $4 to $15 per month is a faster and simpler alternative than applying for a PAP.

en.question: Can I use a Lipitor or Crestor manufacturer coupon with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. Section 1320a-7b) prohibits manufacturer savings cards from being used by anyone enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits. Manufacturer copay cards for brand Lipitor and Crestor are for commercially insured patients only. If you are on Medicare and cannot afford your statin copay, you have two options: switch to the $4 to $15 generic (which should have a $0 to $5 copay on nearly every Part D plan), or apply for the income-based manufacturer PAP if you need the brand for a documented clinical reason.

en.question: Does Medicare Part D cover statins?
en.answer: Yes. Medicare Part D covers all three generic statins (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin) on Tier 1 or Tier 2 with $0 to $5 monthly copays. The statins are not subject to IRA price negotiation because they are already generic and inexpensive. Your total annual out-of-pocket spending for all Part D drugs is capped at $2,100 in 2026 by the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. If your Part D plan is placing a statin on Tier 3 or higher, request a formulary tier exception during your plan's coverage year.

en.question: What if my insurance denies statin coverage?
en.answer: Generic statin coverage denials are rare because every Part D plan and most commercial plans cover at least two statins on Tier 1. If denied, request a written denial notice, then ask your prescriber to file a prior authorization or formulary exception. Most denials for generic statins are reversed quickly. If your plan requires a different statin first under step therapy, your prescriber can file a step-therapy override documenting why the required statin is not appropriate. While appealing, the $4 Walmart generic provides immediate access at minimal cost.

en.question: Do I qualify for the Pfizer RxPathways or AZ&Me patient assistance program?
en.answer: To qualify for Pfizer RxPathways for Lipitor, you must have household income at or below 300 percent of the federal poverty level in 2026, a valid Lipitor prescription, and no commercial prescription drug insurance. For a single-person household, 300 percent FPL is $47,880 per year. For a family of four, the threshold is $99,000. AZ&Me for Crestor uses the same 300 percent FPL threshold for primary care products. Commercially insured patients are not eligible for either program. Most patients can use the $4 to $15 generic instead and bypass the PAP application entirely.

en.question: Which statin is best: Lipitor, Crestor, or Zocor?
en.answer: Clinical guidelines from the American College of Cardiology recommend choosing a statin based on the LDL reduction target, not the brand name. Atorvastatin and rosuvastatin are the two preferred high-intensity statins. At maximum doses, rosuvastatin (40 mg) typically lowers LDL by 55 to 63 percent, and atorvastatin (80 mg) by 49 to 57 percent. Simvastatin carries an FDA warning against the 80 mg dose due to myopathy risk, so it is now primarily used at lower doses for moderate-intensity therapy. For most patients, generic atorvastatin at $4 per month is the cost-effective first choice. Rosuvastatin is preferred for patients with drug interactions on the cytochrome P450 3A4 pathway or who need maximum LDL reduction. Ask your prescriber which statin intensity and dose matches your cardiovascular risk target.

es.question: Cual es la estatina mas barata en 2026?
es.answer: La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) y la simvastatina generica (Zocor) estan disponibles a $4 por mes en Walmart a traves del Programa de Recetas Genericas de $4, sin necesidad de seguro. La rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) esta disponible a $4 a $9 en la mayoria de las cadenas principales con un cupon GoodRx gratuito. Las tres son terapeuticamente efectivas para reducir el LDL. Si esta pagando mas de $25 por mes por cualquier estatina generica, muestre a su farmaceutico un cupon GoodRx gratuito de goodrx.com.

es.question: Hay un generico para Lipitor, Crestor y Zocor?
es.answer: Si. Las tres principales estatinas de marca tienen genericos bioequivalentes aprobados por la FDA. La atorvastatina generica (Lipitor) esta disponible desde noviembre de 2011. La simvastatina generica (Zocor) desde 2006. La rosuvastatina generica (Crestor) desde 2016 despues de que expiraron las ultimas patentes de AstraZeneca. A partir de 2026, mas de 20 fabricantes producen atorvastatina generica y mas de 15 producen rosuvastatina generica. No existen biologicos ni biosimilares para ninguna estatina porque son farmacos sinteticos de molecula pequena.

es.question: Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente para Lipitor o Crestor?
es.answer: Para Lipitor de marca, solicite a traves de Pfizer RxPathways en pfizerrxpathways.com o llame al 1-844-989-PATH (7284). Para Crestor de marca, solicite a traves del programa AZ&Me de AstraZeneca en azandme.com o llame al 1-800-292-6363. Ambos programas requieren ingresos familiares iguales o inferiores al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza, una receta valida y prueba de que no tiene seguro de medicamentos comercial. Para la mayoria de los pacientes, la estatina generica a $4 a $15 por mes es una alternativa mas rapida y sencilla.

es.question: Puedo usar un cupon del fabricante de Lipitor o Crestor con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno (42 U.S.C. Seccion 1320a-7b) prohibe que las tarjetas de ahorro del fabricante sean utilizadas por personas inscritas en Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. Las tarjetas de copago del fabricante son solo para pacientes con seguro comercial. Si tiene Medicare y no puede pagar su copago de estatinas, tiene dos opciones: cambiar al generico de $4 a $15 (que deberia tener un copago de $0 a $5 en casi todos los planes Parte D), o solicitar el PAP basado en ingresos del fabricante.

es.question: Medicare Parte D cubre las estatinas?
es.answer: Si. Medicare Parte D cubre los tres genericos de estatinas (atorvastatina, rosuvastatina, simvastatina) en el Nivel 1 o 2 con copagos mensuales de $0 a $5. Las estatinas no estan sujetas a la negociacion de precios bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion porque ya son genericas y economicas. Su gasto anual total de bolsillo para todos los medicamentos Parte D esta limitado a $2,100 en 2026.

es.question: Que hago si mi seguro niega la cobertura de estatinas?
es.answer: Las denegaciones de cobertura de estatinas genericas son raras porque todos los planes Parte D y la mayoria de los planes comerciales cubren al menos dos estatinas en el Nivel 1. Si se niega, solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito, luego pida a su medico que presente una autorizacion previa o excepcion al formulario. Mientras apela, el generico de $4 de Walmart proporciona acceso inmediato a costo minimo.

es.question: Califico para el programa de asistencia al paciente de Pfizer RxPathways o AZ&Me?
es.answer: Para calificar para Pfizer RxPathways para Lipitor, necesita ingresos familiares iguales o inferiores al 300 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza en 2026, una receta valida de Lipitor y no tener seguro de medicamentos comercial. Para un hogar de una persona, el 300 por ciento del FPL es $47,880 por ano. Para una familia de cuatro, el umbral es $99,000. AZ&Me para Crestor usa el mismo umbral del 300 por ciento del FPL. La mayoria de los pacientes pueden usar el generico de $4 a $15 y evitar la solicitud del PAP.

es.question: Cual estatina es mejor: Lipitor, Crestor o Zocor?
es.answer: Las guias clinicas del Colegio Americano de Cardiologia recomiendan elegir una estatina segun el objetivo de reduccion de LDL, no el nombre de marca. La atorvastatina y la rosuvastatina son las dos estatinas de alta intensidad preferidas. La simvastatina tiene una advertencia de la FDA contra la dosis de 80 mg debido al riesgo de miopatia. Para la mayoria de los pacientes, la atorvastatina generica a $4 por mes es la primera opcion rentable. La rosuvastatina es preferida para pacientes con interacciones medicamentosas o que necesitan maxima reduccion de LDL.
